config.title: Git Graph
config.commitDetailsView.autoCenter.desc: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.fileTr: In the file tree, show a folder that only contains one other folder on one line, for example "src/web/graph".
config.commitDetailsView.location.descri: Where the commit details view opens. Drag the edge of the view to change its height.
config.commitDetailsView.location.enumDe: Open the commit details view below the commit, as a row of the graph.
Open the commit details view in a panel docked to the bottom of the Git Graph view.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.showCh: Show the type of each change (A added, M modified, D deleted, R renamed) as a letter before the file name in the Commit Details View, so that colour is not the only indication.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.type.d: Default view of the changed files in the Commit Details View. The view can be switched with the buttons above the files.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.type.e: Show the changed files as a tree of folders
Show the changed files as a flat list with their paths
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.desc: Hide individual actions from the context menus. Every action is visible unless it is set to false here, for example {"commit": {"reset": false}}.
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.bran: Actions in the context menu of a local branch label.
Rebase current branch on this branch
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.comm: Actions in the context menu of a commit.
Reset current branch to this Commit
Start Code Review / End Code Review
Show only commits by this author
Bisect: Mark as Bad / Good / Skip / Stop
Rebase current branch on this Commit
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.remo: Actions in the context menu of a remote branch label.
Actions in the context menu of a tag label.
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.unco: Actions in the context menu of the "Uncommitted Changes" row.
Amend Last Commit with Uncommitted Changes
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.stas: Actions in the context menu of a stash.
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.descript: Named glob patterns offered in the Branch dropdown, for example {"name": "Feature Branches", "glob": "heads/feature/*"}.
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.items.na: Name shown in the Branch dropdown
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.items.gl: Glob pattern of the references to show, for example "heads/feature/*" or "remotes/origin/release-*". "refs/" is prepended when it is missing.
config.customPullRequestProviders.descri: Pull request providers for hosts other than github.com, gitlab.com and bitbucket.org, for example {"name": "Gitea", "templateUrl": "https://gitea.example.com/$destinationOwner/$destinationRepo/compare/$destinationBranch...$sourceOwner:$sourceBranch"}.
Name shown in the "Create Pull Request" dialog
URL of the "new pull request" page. Variables: $sourceOwner, $sourceRepo, $sourceBranch, $destinationOwner, $destinationRepo, $destinationBranch.
config.date.format.description: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.
config.date.format.enumDescriptions.0: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
config.date.format.enumDescriptions.1: Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
config.date.format.enumDescriptions.2: Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
config.date.type.description: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.
config.date.type.enumDescriptions.0: Use the author date of a commit
config.date.type.enumDescriptions.1: Use the committer date of a commit
config.defaultColumnVisibility.descripti: Default visibility of the Date, Author and Commit columns. Right-click a column header to change the visibility for one repository.
config.dialog.addTag.type.description: Default tag type in the "Add Tag" dialog.
Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox in the "Apply Stash" dialog.
config.dialog.cherryPick.noCommit.descri: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox in the "Cherry Pick" dialog.
config.dialog.cherryPick.recordOrigin.de: Default state of the "Record Origin" checkbox in the "Cherry Pick" dialog (adds a "cherry picked from commit" line to the message).
config.dialog.createBranch.checkOut.desc: Default state of the "Check out" checkbox in the "Create Branch" dialog.
config.dialog.deleteBranch.forceDelete.d: Default state of the "Force Delete" checkbox in the "Delete Branch" dialog.
config.dialog.fetchIntoLocalBranch.force: Default state of the "Force Fetch" checkbox in the "Fetch into Local Branch" dialog.
config.dialog.general.referenceInputSpac: Replace spaces typed into branch and tag name inputs with another character.
Spaces are left as typed (git rejects reference names that contain spaces)
config.dialog.merge.noCommit.description: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox in the merge dialogs.
config.dialog.merge.noFastForward.descri: Default state of the "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" checkbox in the merge dialogs.
config.dialog.merge.squashCommits.descri: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox in the merge dialogs.
Message of the commit that a squash merge creates.
Use "Merge branch '<name>'" (or "Merge commit '<hash>'") as the message of the squash commit
Use the message that git prepares in .git/SQUASH_MSG, which lists the squashed commits
config.dialog.popStash.reinstateIndex.de: Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox in the "Pop Stash" dialog.
config.dialog.pullBranch.noFastForward.d: Default state of the "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" checkbox in the "Pull Branch" dialog.
config.dialog.pullBranch.squashCommits.d: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox in the "Pull Branch" dialog.
config.dialog.rebase.ignoreDate.descript: Default state of the "Ignore Date" checkbox in the "Rebase" dialogs (use the current time as the committer date of the rebased commits).
config.dialog.rebase.launchInteractiveRe: Default state of the "Launch Interactive Rebase in new Terminal" checkbox in the "Rebase" dialogs.
config.dialog.resetCurrentBranchToCommit: Default reset mode in the "Reset current branch to this Commit" dialog.
Keep all changes, but reset head
Keep working tree, but reset index
config.dialog.resetUncommittedChanges.mo: Default reset mode in the "Reset uncommitted changes" dialog.
Keep working tree, but reset index
config.dialog.stashUncommittedChanges.in: Default state of the "Include Untracked" checkbox in the "Stash uncommitted changes" dialog.
config.graph.colours.description: Specifies the colours used on the graph.
config.graph.style.description: Specifies the style of the graph.
config.graph.style.enumDescriptions.0: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.graph.style.enumDescriptions.1: Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.keyboardShortcut.find.description: Letter of the keyboard shortcut that opens the find widget. It is pressed together with Ctrl (Windows, Linux) or Cmd (macOS) while the Git Graph view has focus.
config.keyboardShortcut.refresh.descript: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that refreshes the view.
config.keyboardShortcut.scrollToHead.des: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that scrolls to the checked-out commit.
config.keyboardShortcut.scrollToStash.de: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that scrolls to the next stash (Shift to go to the previous one).
config.maxDepthOfRepoSearch.description: Specifies the maximum depth of subfolders to search when discovering repositories in the workspace.
config.openToTheRepoOfTheActiveTextEdito: When Git Graph is opened, show the repository that contains the document of the active text editor.
config.repository.commits.fetchAvatars.d: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.
config.repository.commits.initialLoad.de: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
config.repository.commits.loadMore.descr: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).
config.repository.commits.loadMoreAutoma: Load more commits automatically when the view is scrolled to the bottom, instead of waiting for the "Load More Commits" button.
config.repository.commits.mute.commitsTh: Show commits that are not ancestors of the checked-out commit with a muted text colour.
config.repository.commits.mute.mergeComm: Show merge commits with a muted text colour.
config.referenceLabels.alignment.descrip: Alignment of the branch and tag labels on each row of the graph.
config.referenceLabels.alignment.enumDes: Show all reference labels before the commit message.
Show branch labels before the commit message, and tag labels at the right end of the Description column.
Show branch labels in the Graph column, next to the graph, and tag labels at the right end of the Description column. The commit messages stay aligned.
config.referenceLabels.combineLocalAndRe: Combine a local branch label with the labels of its remote branches when they point to the same commit (for example "main" and "origin/main" become one label). Right-click the remote part of the label for the remote branch actions.
config.repository.commits.showSignatureS: Show the GPG signature status of each commit in the Commit column and in the Commit Details View. Requires Git 2.4 or later and gpg; loading the graph takes longer because every signed commit is verified.
config.repository.commits.order.descript: Specifies the order of commits on the graph. See the --date-order, --author-date-order and --topo-order options of "git log".
config.repository.commits.order.enumDesc: Commits are shown in commit timestamp order, with parents always after their children
Commits are shown in author timestamp order, with parents always after their children
Commits are shown in topological order: no parent is shown before all of its children, and commits on the same line of history stay together
config.repository.fetchAndPrune.descript: Before fetching from the remote(s) with the Fetch button, remove any remote-tracking references that no longer exist on the remote(s).
config.repository.fetchAndPruneTags.desc: Before fetching from the remote(s) with the Fetch button, remove any local tags that no longer exist on the remote(s). Requires git 2.17 or later and "git-graph.repository.fetchAndPrune".
config.repository.includeCommitsMentione: When "Show All" is selected, also include commits that are only mentioned by reflogs (git log --reflog).
config.repository.onLoad.scrollToHead.de: Scroll to the checked-out commit when a repository is loaded.
config.repository.onLoad.showCheckedOutB: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
Only follow the first parent of commits when loading them (git log --first-parent). Hides the commits that were merged in.
config.repository.showCommitsOnlyReferen: Show commits that are only referenced by tags when "Show All" is selected.
config.repository.showRemoteBranches.des: Default state of the "Show Remote Branches" checkbox when a repository is opened.
config.repository.showRemoteHeads.descri: Show remote HEAD symbolic references, for example "origin/HEAD", on the graph.
config.repository.showStashes.descriptio: Show stashes on the graph. Each stash appears as a row above the commit it was created from.
config.repository.showUncommittedChanges: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).
config.repository.showUntrackedFiles.des: Count untracked files in the "Uncommitted Changes" row. Set to false to speed up loading in repositories with many untracked files.
config.repository.sign.commits.descripti: Sign the commits that Git Graph creates (merge, cherry pick, revert, squash) with GPG or X.509, using the signing key of your git configuration.
config.repository.sign.tags.description: Sign the annotated tags that Git Graph creates with GPG or X.509, using the signing key of your git configuration.
config.repository.useMailmap.description: Apply the .mailmap file of the repository to author and committer names and email addresses.
config.repositoryDropdownOrder.descripti: Order of the repositories in the "Repo" dropdown.
config.repositoryDropdownOrder.enumDescr: Sort by the full path of the repository
Sort by the name of the repository (the last part of its path)
Sort by the order of the workspace folders, then by full path
config.integratedAskpass.description: Let git ask for credentials (HTTPS user names and passwords, SSH passphrases) through a Visual Studio Code input box when no credential helper answers. When false, git actions that need credentials fail instead of prompting.
config.integratedTerminalShell.descripti: Path of the shell executable used by the integrated terminals that Git Graph opens (for example for an interactive rebase). Leave empty to use the default shell of Visual Studio Code. For security reasons this setting can only be set in the User Settings, not in the Workspace Settings.
config.retainContextWhenHidden.descripti: Keep the Git Graph view alive while its tab is hidden, so that it restores instantly. Uses more memory. When false, the view is rebuilt when the tab becomes visible again.
config.stickyHeader.description: Keep the controls bar and the column headers visible while the graph scrolls.
config.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a Status Bar item which opens Git Graph when clicked.
config.sourceCodeProviderIntegrationLoca: Where the "View Git Graph" action appears in the Source Control view.
Show the "View Git Graph" button in the title bar of the Source Control view
Show "View Git Graph" in the "More Actions..." menu of the Source Control view
config.tabIconColourTheme.description: Specifies the colour theme of the icon displayed on the Git Graph tab.
config.tabIconColourTheme.enumDescriptio: Show a colour icon which suits most Visual Studio Code colour themes
Show a grey icon which suits Visual Studio Code colour themes that are predominantly grayscale
config.autoCenterCommitDetailsView.descr: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.
config.dateFormat.description: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.
config.dateFormat.enumDescriptions.0: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
config.dateFormat.enumDescriptions.1: Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
config.dateFormat.enumDescriptions.2: Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
config.dateType.description: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.
config.dateType.enumDescriptions.0: Use the author date of a commit
config.dateType.enumDescriptions.1: Use the committer date of a commit
config.fetchAvatars.description: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.
config.graphColours.description: Specifies the colours used on the graph.
config.graphStyle.description: Specifies the style of the graph.
config.graphStyle.enumDescriptions.0: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.graphStyle.enumDescriptions.1: Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.initialLoadCommits.description: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
config.loadMoreCommits.description: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).
config.showCurrentBranchByDefault.descri: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
config.showUncommittedChanges.descriptio: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).
config.ciStatus.enabled.description: Show the CI status of commits (GitHub check runs and commit statuses, GitLab pipeline statuses) as a dot before the commit hash. github.com uses the built-in GitHub sign-in; every other host asks once for a personal access token that is stored in the secret storage for that host only. Off by default because it calls the provider API. User Settings only.
config.ciStatus.maxCommits.description: How many of the newest loaded commits get their CI status fetched (1 to 100). Lower values use fewer API requests.
config.ciStatus.hosts.markdownDescriptio: Self-hosted instances: host name to provider type, for example `{"git.example.com": "GitLab", "github.example.com": "GitHub"}`. github.com and gitlab.com are recognised without this setting. User Settings only: workspace settings are ignored, so a repository cannot point the extension at another host.
